summary: Round-2 full-task spot audit found one major replay-integrity defect and three minor validation/replay defects. The prior history leakage and partial-original defects are resolved, including all 49 affected production history rows. Prior replay and strict-key findings are only partially resolved. The clean run passes 76 focused/smoke tests (one skip), full 105/105 replay and independent source/season/dependency checks; however the unchanged replay also returns 105/105 after all final-fit lineage is removed, eight supported selection jobs are skipped and report fields are corrupted. No current production metric corruption was found. The accepted augmented2023/H6 and pooled augmented/H6 incompleteness remains honestly represented.
